watchOut: If a broker pays you directly instead of Thunder, the misdirected payment fee is 15% of the invoice or $1,000.
name: Thunder Funding
summary: Non-recourse by default, 90-day agreements and no volume requirement, with some of the latest same-day cutoffs.
differentiator: Its published terms and conditions list the penalty fees that most factors leave to the contract: a misdirected payment fee and a missing notation fee of 15% of the invoice or $1,000, whichever is greater, and a late charge of 0.10% a day. Non-recourse here does not cover disputed loads.

terms.rate: Structured by company size, brokers and freight type; not published
terms.recourse: Non-recourse by default (bankruptcy or insolvency); does not cover short-payments or disputes
terms.contract: 90-day contract, then not bound to a long-term contract
terms.otherFees: Terms list: invoice processing fee; late charge 0.10% of face value per day; misdirected payment fee 15% or $1,000, whichever is greater; missing notation fee 15% or $1,000; unnoted advance fee 10% or $100
terms.speed: Same-day if sent by 12pm PST, next-day by 9pm PST
